findings.identity_explanation: COM-04 line 11 uses the old tag FCU-507 with model CF-12 and location Level 5 east wing, serial not recorded. CR:FCU-L5-08 is CF-12 at Level 5 east wing, but CR:FCU-L5-07 is also CF-12 (at Level 5 west wing). Model does not tell the two units apart and the serial is missing, so only location points to FCU-L5-08 while the tag '507' suggests FCU-L5-07. This is the tag-versus-location case in Matching 3.1, and the contractor's own COR-02 says it does not yet know which unit was tested. The records are not merged.

findings.summary: FCU-L5-08 has a matching FM record, PPM plan, warranty (serial CF12-55108, expires 2028-10-31) and O&M manual, but its only commissioning sheet (COM-04) uses the old tag FCU-507. That sheet could belong to FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08, and the contractor has not confirmed which. The match is uncertain, so I have not merged records and recommend Conflicting information.
findings.escalation_reason: Asset match is uncertain (Escalation 2.2, Matching 3.1): the tag FCU-507 suggests FCU-L5-07 while the location Level 5 east wing matches FCU-L5-08, and no source settles it. The handover manager must decide whether to request on-site verification from the contractor and whether FCU-L5-08 can proceed at the 24 November 2026 handover without a confirmed commissioning certificate.
findings.clarification_to: Main contractor's project manager, Halvorn Contracting (for Brisel MEP Services)
findings.clarification_subject: FCU-L5-08 / FCU-L5-07: confirm which unit commissioning sheet COM-04 (tag FCU-507) covers
findings.clarification_body: Please verify on site, before the 24 November 2026 handover, which fan coil unit was tested on COM-04 (listed as FCU-507, Level 5 east wing, serial not recorded). Confirm whether it is FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08, record the serial from the unit, and confirm whether the other unit has also been commissioned. Please reissue the certificate with the correct tag and serial, with Result and Final approval shown. Your note COR-02 says the check may happen after handover; we cannot treat that as the certificate.
uncertainties: Which unit COM-04 covers is unknown.
The serial of the tested unit is not recorded in COM-04.
It is unknown whether FCU-L5-07 has a separate commissioning certificate (not checked in this investigation).
